title: Denmark – Vehicle refuelling services – Koncessionsaftale vedr. varetagelse af drift og vedligeholdelse af brændstofanlæg for Billund Lufthavn
description: Udbudsprocessen omfatter en kontrakt til Ordregivers varetagelse af drift og vedligeholdelse af brændstofanlæg for Billund Lufthavn. Brændstofanlægget er placeret nærtliggende uden for lufthavnsområdet og benyttes af kunder med bil. Det nuværende brændstofanlæg drives af OK a.m.b.a. (OK). Kontrakten ophører ved udgangen af april 2027. Anlægget er ubemandet. Der er pt. fire standere til selvbetjening, hvorfra der kan tankes benzin og diesel. Ordregiver ønsker med nærværende udbud at indgå en koncessionskontrakt med en Tilbudsgiver, som, udover at forestå den daglige drift af et ubemandet brændstofanlæg, kan være med til at udvikle brændstofanlægget i takt med den store udvikling, som området gennemgår. Ordregivers antal af kunder der benytter lufthavnen vækster 3 – 5% årligt, og der forventes at være op mod 7 mio. årlige kunder om 20 år. Ligeledes vækster nærområdet i form af både Lalandia og Lego, som ligeledes har flere millioner gæster årligt. Dertil kommer den øvrige generelt positive udvikling i området, der bidrager til forventningerne om et konstant stigende omsætningspotentiale på brændstofanlægget. Vindende Tilbudsgiver vil have mulighed for at indgå aftale med Ordregivers personaleforening om særlig rabataftale eller lignende. En sådan aftale er dog uden betydning for valget af fremtidig koncessionshaver og for dette udbud i øvrigt. Estimeret omsætningspotentiale i liter pr. år er på nuværende tidspunkt ca. 2,5 mio. liter. Omsætningen skønnes at være faldende med ca. 5-10 % pr. år over de kommende år grundet udviklingen i salget af el-biler.

title: Copenhagen - New Metroline, M5 Civil Works South
description: This tender presents a substantial opportunity for prospective contractors to bid for the M5 Civil Works South (CWS) package, an important component of the Copenhagen metro system's expansion. This project is of significant strategic importance, as the M5 line is a fully automated driverless metro system that will not only enhance passenger service on existing metro corridors but also extend connectivity to emerging urban development areas, including Kløverparken, Refshaleøen, and Lynetteholm in the East Harbour. The M5 is designed to operate as an independent system, ensuring that its construction and subsequent operation do not disrupt the existing M1-M4 metro lines. MAIN COMPONENTS OF THE M5 CIVIL WORK The M5 south consists of approx 6.5 km twin bored TBM tunnels, 5 underground stations (incl. 3 transfer stations), 2 underground crossovers, 1 shaft, 5 cross passages, 1 ramp, approx 2.0 km viaduct, 1 elevated station, 1 viaduct cross-over, 1 elevated bifurcation, short embankment sections. For further details on scope ref. is made to M5-2.1-CMBS-SW and M5-2.2-CWS-SW PHASES: The current tender, Phase 1, encompasses the southern section of the line, from north-west of København H to north of v/Prags Boulevard, with an anticipated operational commencement in 2036. The broader vision includes phase 2 north of v/Prags Boulevard to Lynetteholm opening in 2045 and a potential future extension to form a ring line, signifying a long-term commitment to urban mobility. Phase 2 is not included in this tender. CONTRACT SPLIT OF M5: The M5 project as a whole consists of several contracts: • M5 Civil Works South (this contract) • M5 Transportation System South contract (tendered out as a separate contract in June 2026) • Operation and Maintenance contract (will be tendered out at a later stage) • Enabling Works contracts, e.g. relocation of utilities, relocation works at Kh etc. (enabling works will be tendered out in separate contracts) • Station and Shaft areas (will be tendered out at a later stage) • Canopy contracts (will be tendered out at a later stage). CONTRACT The contract is structured as a design & build contract under ABT18 terms, placing comprehensive responsibility for both design and execution upon the Contractor. This two-phase approach—design followed by execution—is a standard framework for complex infrastructure projects. A market dialogue has been carried out before issuing the tender. The purpose of the market dialogue was to ensure that the project is attractive to the market, and to ensure competitive and compliant final tenders to be used as basis for the award of contract. Metroselskabet I/S is grateful for the potential tenderers who took their time to participate in the dialogue and provided input. INDICATIVE TIMESCHEDULE FOR THE PROCUREMENT Publication of contract notice September 10th 2026. Publication of tender documentation September 11th 2026. Deadline for submission of application for prequalification October 13th 2026, ref. made to section 5.1.12. Dialogue phase November 2026-October 2027. Final tender November 2027. Award of contract December 2027. The time-schedule may be subject to change.

title: Vybavení nové kavárny
description: Předmětem plnění této veřejné zakázky malého rozsahu bude dodávka a montáž vybavení nové kavárny v budově sídla zadavatele, a to v souladu s požadavky a projektem podrobněji specifikovanými ve výzvě k předložení cenové nabídky a v jejích přílohách. Požadované plnění sestává zejména z chladících a mrazících zařízení, nerezového vybavení (regály a police, pracovní stoly, mycí stoly, mycí stoly vč. dřezů a baterií apod.), pecí, myčky, výrobníku sody, výrobníku ledu, výrobníku „hotdogů“ atd. Detailní popis všech dodávaných položek zařízení je obsažen ve vzorové Kupní smlouvě, která tvoří Přílohu č. 1 výzvy a v jejím rámci pak konkrétně v její příloze 1 – Dispozici provozu (nákres rozmístění technologie v prostorách nové kavárny) a v příloze 2 – Položkovém rozpočtu, obsahujícím rovněž veškeré požadované (nepodkročitelné) technické parametry jednotlivých položek zařízení. Součástí předmětu plnění veřejné zakázky, kromě dodání jednotlivých položek zařízení dle technické specifikace – dispozice provozu a položkového rozpočtu, bude dále poskytnutí s dodáním technologie souvisejících služeb, zejména přesné zaměření místa plnění před výrobou/obstaráním jednotlivých položek zařízení, a to v případě potřeby i opakovaně, zpracování dílenské (výrobní) dokumentace (je-li relevantní), uskladnění zařízení „u vybraného dodavatele“ či na jiném bezpečném místě na potřebnou dobu do okamžiku dopravy a instalace zařízení na místo plnění, dále balení a doprava jednotlivých položek zařízení na místo plnění, nastěhování, instalace zařízení, včetně veškerých elektromontážních, instalatérských (zejm. voda, odpady) a dalších souvisejících prací, uvedení kompletní technologie do provozu, provedení (zajištění) veškerých potřebných souhlasů, povolení a revizí nezbytných k řádnému provozu technologie v souladu s platnou legislativou a technickými normami, likvidace odpadů, zaškolení pracovníků zadavatele s obsluhou zařízení, dodání návodů k veškerým zařízením v českém jazyce (v tištěné podobě i v digitální podobě, video návod základního ovládání) apod.

title: Belgium – Event services – Raamovereenkomst externe cateringpartners maatwerk en evenementen
description: Voorwerp van deze diensten: Raamovereenkomst externe cateringpartners maatwerk en evenementen Toelichting: Hogeschool VIVES Zuid en VIVES Noord organiseert jaarlijks een brede waaier aan evenementen en “High-end” maatwerkopdrachten binnen zowel de campussen Noord als Zuid, die zich verspreid bevinden in de provincie West-Vlaanderen. Deze activiteiten maken integraal deel uit van het academisch en maatschappelijk functioneren van de hogeschool en vragen een professionele, kwalitatieve en betrouwbare cateringondersteuning. De catering speelt hierbij een cruciale rol in de beleving, uitstraling en organisatorische kwaliteit van deze momenten. Fases van de opdracht: 1ste fase – Selectie Onderhavig document betreft de eerste fase, met name de selectiefase, van een plaatsingsprocedure in twee stappen. In deze eerste fase wordt enkel een “Aanvraag tot deelneming” gevraagd, aangevuld met de nodige bijlagen, waarmee de kandidaat zijn interesse voor de opdracht betoont, zijn schriftelijke wil uit om geselecteerd te worden (artikel 2, 12° Wet Overheidsopdrachten 17 juni 2016) en de gevraagde verantwoordingsstukken overmaakt teneinde geselecteerd te kunnen worden. 2de fase - Gunning Na de selectie kunnen enkel de geselecteerde kandidaten deelnemen aan de tweede fase, de gunningsfase, op basis van het bestek dat hen zal worden bezorgd na de selectiebeslissing. In deze tweede fase zullen de geselecteerde kandidaten op basis van het bestek worden uitgenodigd om een offerte in te dienen. Percelen: - voor perceel 1 “Evenementen” zoeken wij drie externe cateringpartners die de hogeschool gedurende een periode van vier jaar kunnen ondersteunen bij onderstaande activiteiten die flexibel inzetbaar zijn over alle campussen heen dus over de gehele provincie West-Vlaanderen kunnen bedienen. Evenementen: Elk academiejaar voorziet Hogeschool VIVES onder andere 3 grootschalige institutionele evenementen waaronder de Academische Opening in september, de Nieuwjaarsreceptie in januari en de Pro-dag in mei; Voor deze evenementen wordt telkens een opkomst verwacht van ongeveer 700 tot 1.000 aanwezigen. Daarnaast organiseert Hogeschool VIVES jaarlijks meerdere proclamaties, promotiezittingen etc. gespreid over de verschillende studiegebieden. Deze plechtigheden vinden plaats per opleiding of groep en richten zich op studenten en hun ouders of begeleiders. Ook voor deze momenten is een aangepaste, verzorgde en vlot georganiseerde catering vereist, rekening houdend met variërende groepsgroottes, locaties en praktische omstandigheden. - voor perceel 2 “maatwerkopdrachten” zoeken wij eveneens drie externe cateringpartners, voor aanzienlijk kleinere opdrachten van gemiddeld 10 tot 50 personen waar een uitzonderlijk hoog kwaliteitsniveau primeert, zowel op vlak van producten, presentatie en service. “High-end” maatwerkopdrachten: Dit perceel heeft betrekking op de levering van hoogwaardige, op maat uitgewerkte cateringdiensten, waarbij de nadruk expliciet ligt op kwaliteit, exclusiviteit en beleving. De aanbestedende overheid beoogt met dit perceel de selectie van dienstverleners die in staat zijn om cateringconcepten te ontwikkelen en te realiseren die volledig afgestemd zijn op de specifieke context, doelstellingen en doelgroep van elk evenement. Het betreft hierbij geen standaardaanbod, maar telkens een unieke invulling waarbij maatwerk centraal staat. Looptijd De raamovereenkomst heeft een initiële looptijd van vier jaar, op voorwaarde dat de geraamde maximale waarde van de opdracht binnen deze termijn niet wordt overschreden. De aanbestedende overheid vestigt de aandacht van de kandidaat op het feit dat de aangegeven maximumwaarde niet is berekend op basis van de vermoedelijke hoeveelheden in de inventaris. Deze maximale waarde biedt dus geen aanwijzing voor het offertebedrag waarvoor de inschrijving kan worden gegund. Het gaat in dit geval over de maximale waarde van de raamovereenkomst, die vastgesteld is op basis van de maximaal te bestellen hoeveelheden over alle opdrachten die de aanbestedende overheid kan plaatsen. Om de omvang van de opdracht te controleren, houdt de aanbestedende overheid toezicht over de uitgaven in kader van de raamovereenkomst om ervoor te zorgen dat zij de maximale waarde van de raamovereenkomst niet overschrijden. Bij overschrijding van de maximale waarde, kunnen er geen nieuwe bestellingen worden geplaatst.

title: Ireland – Works for complete or part construction and civil engineering work – Shesknan Bridge Works
description: The project involves the replacement/rehabilitation of a single-span road bridge in poor structural condition and has partially collapsed. Works will focus on the replacement of bridge deck and parapet walls, abutment and wingwall re-pointing, vegetation clearance, and associated ancillary works. Shesknan Bridge is a single-span masonry arch bridge of approximately 6m span, supporting a local road crossing over a natural watercourse. The bridge consists of a masonry arch barrel, stone sidewalls and parapets, with a relatively shallow depth of fill material supporting the road surface above. The recommended solution for the bridge is full replacement. This addresses advanced deterioration including reinforcement corrosion, section loss and spalling, which render repair-only strategies uneconomical and short-lived. Additional works are anticipated to include the following:  Site mobilisation and establishment.  Temporary works and access provision.  Demolition of defective components.  Parapet, abutment and wingwall works.  Vegetation clearance and habitat measures.  Road reinstatement, surfacing and safety barrier installation.  Final inspection and handover.

description: Neubau eines Stellwerks auf einem Streckenabschnitt von ca. 7,7 Kilometern einer mit 750 V DC elektrifizierten öffentlichen Eisenbahn (Hauptbahn) zwischen den Bahnhöfen Wesseling Süd und Bornheim-Hersel mit 28 Weicheneinheiten, 10 vorhandenen hauptsignalabhängigen Bahnübergangssicherungsanlagen, Ausrüstung mit Ks-Signalen in LED-Technik, neuer Gleisfreimeldung, Stromversorgung, Kabellieferung und -verlegung, Zugbeeinflussung PZB und magnetischer Fahrsperre, Anpassung der Nachbarstellwerke vom Typ Siemens SICAS ECC und SpDrS60, Einbindung in das vorhandene VICOS-Bediensystem, Projektierung der Zuglenkung, Neubau eines Stellwerksgebäudes, Prüfleistungen, Inbetriebnahme und Abnahmeprüfung. Die gelieferte Stellwerkstechnik muss für den Betrieb bei öffentlichen Eisenbahnen in Deutschland uneingeschränkt zugelassen sein, den anerkannten Regeln der Technik entsprechen und AK 7/SIL 4 erfüllen, Weichen mit beweglichen Herzstückspitzen unterstützen und für den Verkehr mit Stadtbahnfahrzeugen mit von der EBO abweichenden Rädern geeignet sein. Alle Zulassungen müssen zum Zeitpunkt der Angebotsabgabe uneingeschränkt vorliegen. Fertigstellung und Inbetriebnahme sind zwingend im August 2028 erforderlich. Das neue Stellwerk wird in den nächsten Jahren voraussichtlich um einen weiteren Bahnhof in derselben Technik erweitert.

title: Germany – Construction works for plants, mining and manufacturing and for buildings relating to the oil and gas industry – Bau und Ausrüstung der Demonstrationsanlage MoorFaserWerk Malchin (Verbundprojekt MOOReturn)
description: Errichtung einer industriellen Aufbereitungsanlage zur Verarbeitung von Grasschnitt und Laub aus der Landschaftspflege zu pelletierten oder brikettierten Festbrennstoffen (Kapazität ca. 3.100 t/a) am Standort Industriegelände 6, 17139 Malchin, im Rahmen des vom BMEL über die FNR geförderten Verbundprojekts MOOReturn. Der Auftrag umfasst als Generalübernehmerleistung: Planung (einschließlich Genehmigungsplanung), Bauleistungen (Ertüchtigung der Bestandshalle inkl. Hallentore, Medienerschließung, brandschutztechnischer Ertüchtigung, Sozial- und Sanitärräume) sowie die Beschaffung und Montage sämtlicher Anlagenkomponenten der Prozesskette (Dosierung, Waschmaschine, Abtropftrommel, Feinzerkleinerung, Pressentwässerung, thermische Trocknung, Verdichtung). Die Vergabe als integrierte Gesamtleistung dient der Vermeidung von Schnittstellenrisiken und der Sicherstellung einer einheitlichen, vom Generalübernehmer verantworteten Anlagenkonformität. Die Umsetzung des Auftrags ist in aufeinander aufbauenden Leistungsstufen vorgesehen. Der Auftraggeber beabsichtigt, einzelne Leistungsstufen entsprechend dem Projektfortschritt abzurufen. Die Beauftragung weiterer Leistungsstufen erfolgt jeweils vorbehaltlich der Bereitstellung der Fördermittel sowie des Erreichens der definierten Projektmeilensteine. Ein Anspruch auf Beauftragung weiterer Leistungsstufen besteht nicht. Ausführliche Beschreibung des Beschaffungsvorhabens s. Anlage 1 unter folgendem Link: https://www.dbfz.de/fileadmin/Projektseiten/MooReturn/doc/MoorFaserWerk_Malchin_Kurzexpose_v1.pdf

title: Germany – Load-bearing structure design services – Planungsleistungen Tragwerksplanung gemäß HOAI, Teil 4, Abschnitt 1, §51 für die Maßnahme Neubau/Anbau: Kindergarten Renquishausen
description: Die Gemeinde Renquishausen plant den Neubau eines 4-gruppigen Kindergartens in der Ortsmitte, angrenzend an das Gemeindezentrum. Innerhalb des Gemeindezentrums werden ehemalige Schulräume künftig nicht mehr benötigt und stehen zur Erweiterung der Feuerwehr und für die Nutzung durch den neuen Kindergarten zur Verfügung. Die Verbindung der Bestandsstruktur und Erweiterung soll den Nutzern einen modernen Kindergarten und Synergien mit den bestehenden Nutzungen bieten. Nach einem erfolgten VgV-Verhandlungsverfahren mit Teilnahmewettbewerb und Lösungsvorschlag wurden die Objektplanung Gebäude und die Außenanlagen bereits vergeben. Ziel der Gemeinde Renquishausen ein, den aktuellen pädagogischen Maßstäben entsprechender, 4-gruppiger Kindergarten als Holz-Hybridbau. Das Grundstück befindet sich in stadträumlich anspruchsvoller Hanglage. Der zweigeschossige Neubau nutzt die Höhenentwicklung für ebenerdige Zugänge in beiden Geschossen. Der Neubau bindet über einen eingeschossen Zwischenbau mit Dachterrasse an die bestehende Gemeindehalle an.

title: Finland – ENT or audiologist services – Kuulokojeiden sovitus- ja huoltopalvelut ÖVPH Pohjoinen alue
description: Hankinnan kohteena on kuulokojeiden sovitus- ja ylläpitopalvelu Pohjanmaan hyvinvointialueen pohjoisella osa-alueella. Palveluun sisältyy lääkinnällisenä kuntoutuksena myönnettyjen kuulokojeiden sovitus ja ylläpitopalvelu sekä muiden yksittäisten korvakappaleisiin ja kuulokojeisiin liittyvien huoltotoimenpiteiden hankinta kaudelle 1.1.2027 - 31.12.2028. Hankintaan sisältyy kaksi kertaa yhden (1 + 1) vuoden optiomahdollisuus (1.1.2029-31.12.2029 ja 1.1.2030-31.12.2030). Option käyttämisestä tehdään erikseen päätös noin kuusi (6) kuukautta ennen sopimuskauden päättymistä. Toiminta-alue on Pohjoinen alue, johon kuuluu Pietarsaari, Kruunupyy, Luoto, Pedersöre ja Uusikaarlepyy. Pietarsaaren alueella on noin 250 kuulonhuoltoasiakasta per vuosi. Asiakasmäärä on arvio eikä tilaaja sitoudu tiettyihin hankintamääriin. Palvelun asiakkaalla on oltava palvelua varten korva-, nenä- ja kurkkutautien toimintayksikön toimintaperiaatteiden mukaisesti hyväksytty lähete tai apuvälinepäätös, jonka määräysten mukaan kuulokojepalvelu toteutetaan. Tilaaja varaa oikeuden tarkastella palvelun järjestämistapaa sopimuskauden aikana. Tarkastelun seurauksena palvelun laajuus voi muuttua tai palvelu voidaan osittain tai kokonaan siirtää tilaajan omaksi toiminnaksi hankintasopimuksen ehtojen mukaisesti.

title: Germany – Load-bearing structure design services – Planungsleistungen Tragwerksplanung gemäß HOAI, Teil 4, Abschnitt 1, §51 für die Maßnahme Neubau/Anbau: Kindergarten Renquishausen
description: Die Gemeinde Renquishausen plant den Neubau eines 4-gruppigen Kindergartens in der Ortsmitte, angrenzend an das Gemeindezentrum. Innerhalb des Gemeindezentrums werden ehemalige Schulräume künftig nicht mehr benötigt und stehen zur Erweiterung der Feuerwehr und für die Nutzung durch den neuen Kindergarten zur Verfügung. Die Verbindung der Bestandsstruktur und Erweiterung soll den Nutzern einen modernen Kindergarten und Synergien mit den bestehenden Nutzungen bieten. Nach einem erfolgten VgV-Verhandlungsverfahren mit Teilnahmewettbewerb und Lösungsvorschlag wurden die Objektplanung Gebäude und die Außenanlagen bereits vergeben. Ziel der Gemeinde Renquishausen ein, den aktuellen pädagogischen Maßstäben entsprechender, 4-gruppiger Kindergarten als Holz-Hybridbau. Das Grundstück befindet sich in stadträumlich anspruchsvoller Hanglage. Der zweigeschossige Neubau nutzt die Höhenentwicklung für ebenerdige Zugänge in beiden Geschossen. Der Neubau bindet über einen eingeschossen Zwischenbau mit Dachterrasse an die bestehende Gemeindehalle an.

title: Finland – CT scanners – Liikuteltava kuvantamisyksikkö (mobiili-TT) HUS Diagnostiikkakeskukseen
description: Hankinnan kohteena on yhden (1) uuden tietokonetomografialaitteiston sisältävän liikuteltavan kuvantamisyksikön eli mobiili-TT:n hankinta HUS Diagnostiikkakeskuksen käyttöön. Perävaunuun sijoitettava tietokonetomografialaitteisto on ns. perustason TT-laitteisto. Laitteiston tulee soveltua monipuolisesti päivystystutkimuksiin, joista tavanomaisimpia ovat pään ja vartalon alueen sekä nivel- ja raajatutkimukset mukaan lukien traumakuvaukset. Lisäksi laitteistolla tehtäviä tutkimuksia ovat verisuoniangiografiat, aivoperfuusiot sekä perustason sepelvaltimokuvaukset ja muut EKG-tahdistetut kuvaukset. Laitteiston tutkimusmäärä voi vaihdella, mutta tavanomaisen tutkimusmäärän arvioidaan olevan n. 5000–7000 tutkimusta vuodessa. Hankittavan laitteiston tulee soveltua yllä kuvattuun käyttötarkoitukseen. Hankinnalle asetettu kattohinta on 1,1 M€ (alv 0%), sisältäen ehdottomat vaatimukset mukaisen peruskokoonpanon ja kokonaisuudessaan liikuteltavan kuvantamisyksikön kokonaisuuden. Kattohinta ei pidä sisällään pakollisia optioita tai huoltosopimuksen kustannuksia. Mikäli tarjotun laitteiston hinta ylittää edellä mainitun kattohinnan, tarjous hylätään. Optiona varataan oikeus enintään kolmen (3) lisälaitteiston hankintaan HUS-yhtymän toiminta-alueelle tai laajemmin valtakunnalliseen käyttöön (HUS Diagnostiikkakeskuksen koordinoimana) vuosien 2027-2030 aikana. Tarjouksessa ilmoitetut hinnat ovat kiinteät 31.12.2027 asti, jos tarjouspyynnössä tai sen liitteissä ei ole toisin mainittu. Toimittajalla ei ole oikeutta muuttaa hintoja tänä aikana. Hintoja voidaan korottaa vain todellista kustannusten muutosta vastaavasti, optiolaitteiden (2028-2030) osalta sopimusluonnokseen allekirjoitushetkellä kirjatun indeksin mukaisesti. Optiohankinnat eivät ole sitovia. HUS tekee päätöksen mahdollisesta optiohankinnasta ilman ostovelvoitetta tarpeensa mukaisesti. Hankintayksikkö voi keskeyttää hankinnan, mikäli hankkeen rahoitus ei toteudu suunnitellulla tavalla. HUS harkitsee, missä laajuudessa se tekee laitteistojen huoltosopimukset vai hoidetaanko huolto sairaalan omana toimintana. Hankinnan kohde ja sitä koskevat vaatimukset on kuvattu yksityiskohtaisesti tarjouspyynnössä ja sen liitteissä. Vaihtoehtoiset tarjoukset eivät ole sallittuja. Rinnakkaiset tarjoukset eivät ole sallittuja.

title: Finland – Lift-maintenance services – Oulun Tilapalvelut - Hissien huolto- ja korjauspalvelut
description: HANKINNAN KOHDE Oulun Tilapalvelut -liikelaitos pyytää tarjoustanne hallinnoimiensa kiinteistöjen hissien huolto- ja korjauspalveluista sekä hälytyskeskuspalveluista. Hankinnan kohteena ovat hissien kokonaisvaltainen huolto-, kunnossapito-, korjaus- ja päivystyspalvelu. Palveluun sisältyvät lisäksi hissien toiminnan ylläpitämiseksi tarvittavat muut huolto- ja korjaustoimenpiteet. Palvelun tavoitteena on varmistaa hissien turvallinen, luotettava ja keskeytyksetön toiminta sekä ylläpitää laitteiden tekninen kunto valmistajien ohjeiden, viranomaismääräysten ja hyvän kunnossapitotavan mukaisesti. Hankinnan tarkempi sisältö on kuvattu tämän tarjouspyynnön liitteessä 1 (Palvelunkuvaus). Lisäksi liitteessä 2, (Laiteluettelo / Tarjousliite) on kerrottu jokaisen hissin vaadittu huoltomäärä vuodessa. SOPIMUSJÄRJESTELY Hankinnasta muodostetaan puitejärjestely yhden (1) palveluntuottajan kanssa. TOIMEKSIANTOJEN TOTEUTUS Perushuollot toteutetaan sovitun huolto-ohjelman mukaisesti. Kiireettömien töiden tilaukset tehdään P2P-tilausjärjestelmällä, joka toimii samalla tilauksen sopimuksena. Tilauksen yhteydessä sovitaan toimeksiannon sisältö, aikataulu sekä arvioitu työmäärä. Mikäli sovitusta aikataulusta myöhästytään palveluntuottajasta johtuvasta syystä, tilaajalla on oikeus periä sopimusluonnoksen mukaiset sanktiot. HINNOITTELU JA TARJOUKSEN SISÄLTÖ Tarjous tulee laatia tämän tarjouspyynnön ja sen liitteiden mukaisesti. Tarjouksen tulee kattaa kaikki palvelun toteuttamiseksi tarvittavat työt. Mahdolliset lisätyöt hinnoitellaan tarjouspyynnön mukaisesti. Perushuollot laskutetaan laitekohtaisilla tarjoushinnoilla. Muut huolto- ja korjaustyöt laskutetaan tarjotun tuntihinnan sekä toteutuneen materiaalikulutuksen mukaisesti. SOPIMUSKAUSI Sopimuskausi on kaksi (2) vuotta. Sopimuskauden tavoiteltu alkamispäivä on 1.12.2026. Mikäli sopimuskauden aloitus viivästyy esimerkiksi muutoksenhaun vuoksi, sopimuskausi alkaa vasta, kun asiaan on saatu lainvoimainen ratkaisu. Määräaikaisen sopimuskauden jälkeen sopimusta voidaan jatkaa optioilla: - yksi (1) + yksi (1) vuotta Optiokaudet alkavat tavoitellusti: - 1.11.2028 (1. optiovuosi) - 1.11.2029 (2. optiovuosi) Tilaaja päättää optioiden käytöstä. Sopimus jatkuu optiokausille automaattisesti, ellei tilaaja ilmoita kirjallisesti halustaan olla käyttämättä optiota viimeistään kuusi (6) kuukautta ennen kunkin optiokauden alkamista. HISSIEN LISÄÄMINEN JA POISTAMINEN Sopimuskaudella hankinnan kohteet voivat lisääntyä tai vähentyä ja tilaajalla on oikeus lisätä tai poistaa kohteita sopimuksesta ilman irtisanomisaikaa. Lisättyihin ja poistettuihin kohteisiin sovelletaan tarjouksen mukaisia hintatasoja. TAKUUAIKAISTEN HISSIEN HUOLTOVASTUU Tämä hankinta ei koske takuuaikaisia huolto- ja korjauspalveluja. Takuuaikaiset hissit pysyvät toimituksesta tai hissin korjauksesta vastanneen toimittajan huollossa takuuajan päättymiseen saakka. Takuuajan päätyttyä huolto- ja korjausvastuu siirtyy tämän sopimuksen mukaiselle palveluntuottajalle. Tilaaja ilmoittaa palveluntuottajalle takuuajan päättymisajankohdan. SOPIMUSEHDOT JA HANKINTAPÄÄTÖS Palvelussa noudatetaan JYSE 2025 -ehtoja. Tilaajalla on oikeus hylätä kaikki tarjoukset perustellusta syystä. Tarjoukset eivät saa sisältää tarjoajan omia ehtoja. HANKINNAN KÄYTTÄJÄT Sopimusta voivat käyttää Oulun Tilapalvelut -liikelaitoksen lisäksi myös muut Oulun kaupungin hallintokunnat ja liikelaitokset, joilla on sama Y-tunnus, kuten Oulun Kaupunkiympäristöpalvelut ja Oulun Vesi.

Requirement Details Tendering Procedure: Selective Tendering This requirement is open only to those TBIPS Supply Arrangement Holders who qualified under Tier 1 for services in the National Capital Region for the following categories: • Category A.1. Application/Software Architect Level 3 • Category I.2. Database Administrator Level 3 • Category I.6. Network Analyst Level 3 • Category I.11. Technology Architect Level 3 The following SA Holders have been invited to submit a proposal: • Accenture Inc. • ADRM Technology Consulting Group Corp. • BoonBridge Corporation • CDW Canada Corp. • CGI Information Systems and Management Consultants Inc. • Cofomo Inc. • Deloitte Inc. • Donna Cona Inc., IBM Canada Limited Joint Venture • Flex Tech Services Inc • Primex Project Management Limited • Prologic Systems Ltd., and Maplesoft Consulting Inc. in JV • Skyfly Solutions Inc., iFathom Corp., EPI-Use Now Inc. in Joint Venture • Spaghetti Logic Inc. • TRM Technologies Inc. • Xelerance Corporation Description of Work: The objective of this requirement is to augment knowledge within the Department of Justice Canada’s (JUS) Cloud team to gather expertise and meet project requirements and specific AI initiatives. The required professional services will support the delivery of key infrastructure components, networking fixes and improvements as well as high visibility projects such as Otto , Artificial Intelligence and the Lakehouse. The Cloud Engineer will implement, configure, automate, and support cloud infrastructure, platform services, and cloud-native solutions in accordance with Government of Canada Cloud Guardrails, departmental standards, enterprise architecture principles, and security controls. The Cloud Engineer will support the deployment, integration, modernization, and operational management of Microsoft Azure services, enterprise applications, AI-enabled solutions, and hybrid cloud environments. The Cloud Engineer will collaborate with the Cloud Centre of Expertise (CCoE), Shared Services Canada (SSC), Security Operations, infrastructure teams, application teams, and project stakeholders to deploy, configure, monitor, troubleshoot, automate, and document cloud services, platform components, application hosting environments, identity services, storage, networking, and operational processes while supporting continuous improvement, operational excellence, and knowledge transfer. The Cloud Architect will design, document, and provide technical leadership for the Department's cloud architecture, ensuring compliance with Government of Canada Cloud Guardrails, departmental standards, security controls, and enterprise architecture principles. The Cloud Architect will support cloud infrastructure, cloud-native applications, application modernization initiatives, Azure platform services, AI-enabled solutions, and hybrid architectures. Responsibilities include the design of governance models, subscription hierarchies, landing zones, security architecture, integration patterns, DevSecOps practices, application hosting models, and reference architectures to support enterprise cloud adoption and integration with on-premises and cloud-based services. The Network Specialist will design, implement, document, and support cloud and hybrid networking solutions that provide secure, resilient, and high-performing connectivity between cloud, on-premises, partner, and externally hosted environments. The specialist will support enterprise cloud platforms, cloud-native applications, application modernization initiatives, AI-enabled solutions, and hybrid architectures by designing and implementing networking services, secure integration patterns, and connectivity solutions. The Network Specialist will collaborate with Shared Services Canada (SSC), internal Security Operations, infrastructure teams, application teams, and project stakeholders to design, implement, validate, and document network connectivity, firewall configurations, DNS services, certificate management, identity integration, private connectivity, and network security controls in accordance with Government of Canada standards and departmental policies. The Database Administrator will design, implement, maintain, and optimize database platforms across on-premises and Azure environments, ensuring the availability, performance, security, and recoverability of business-critical systems. The Database Administrator will implement and support backup, restore, high availability, disaster recovery, monitoring, and security controls, while providing technical advice and documentation related to database migrations, cloud integration, and operational best practices in coordination with application teams, Shared Services Canada (SSC), and internal security stakeholders. Bidders must submit a bid for all resource categories. Security Requirement: All Contractor personnel must hold at a minimum, a Personnel security screening level of Reliability. Privileged users require a Personnel Security screening level of Secret. Unscreened personnel are prohibited from performing services under the Contract. title: Radon Measurement Device Evaluation 2026 - 2031
description: Health Canada requires services to ensure that radon measurement devices available in Canada are evaluated for their performance on an annual basis. This is to ensure that any new entrants to the marketplace are evaluated within a reasonable timeframe to ensure they meet minimum performance standards. As a result of this service the vendor will produce a series of publicly available consumer reports on commercially available electronic radon testing devices to ensure the findings of these tests are communicated with consumers. Health Canada will use the information to review testing guidelines, recommendations and protocols. The scope of this work encompasses the development and ongoing administration of a performance evaluation and testing program for radon measurement devices commercially available to Canadian consumers. The work must be designed to assess device performance under conditions that reflect how residents would realistically deploy and use such devices in their homes, ensuring that test results are representative of actual indoor radon activity concentrations.

title: Real Property capital project delivery services
description: Department of Foreign Affairs, Trade and Development (DFATD) advances Canada’s values and interests internationally, delivers international programs and administers Canada’s international aid program to alleviate poverty in the developing world and provide humanitarian assistance. The department provides commercial and consular services to Canadians at home and abroad and manages the Government of Canada’s global network of missions. DFATD is the custodian of a diverse international real estate portfolio and delivers real property services to support Government of Canada program objectives through the provision of safe, secure, productive, environmentally sustainable and affordable workplaces and services that function for its employees and partners, while contributing to the support and promotion of Canada’s posture on the world stage. A new procurement vehicle is required to procure services to support a wide range of potential project delivery methods leveraging private sector expertise and capacity, including for investment analysis, architecture and engineering design, property maintenance and construction to meet ongoing DFATD needs. DFATD requires various categories of professional service experts with experience in the management and administration of real property to support the delivery of capital projects.

title: RFSA for Ghost Gear Retrieval Services
description: Important Note: The closing date for the initial RFSA solicitation period is the date posted on page 1 of the RFSA Document. The closing date posted on the CanadaBuys webpage serves only to allow for ongoing qualification as outlined in section Supply Arrangement under article 3.1 On-going Opportunity for Qualification of the RFSA. Any arrangements received late will not be considered and will need to be resubmitted during the next available qualification period: April and September of each year. This requirement is for the Department of Fisheries and Oceans (DFO). Title: Request for Supply Arrangement – Ghost Gear The Department of Fisheries and Oceans Canada has a requirement to establish Supply Arrangements for crews and vessels capable of retrieving and appropriately disposing of ghost gear in Canadian waters when the need arises. DFO’s retrieval requirement might be different every time ghost gear is reported due to the conditions, location, sensitive habitats and gear type. DFO does not know the specific requirements until the location and gear is observed. • Retrieval activities may include: mapping capacity (ie. Side scan sonar or similar) to identify targets • Retrieval (by various methods including but not limited to: by hand from vessel, commercial diver, remotely operated vehicle (ROV), barge and excavator). • Transportation to disposal location which may require a boat, barge, truck, etc. • Disposal, including recycling when appropriate PERIOD OF THE SUPPLY ARRANGEMENT The resulting Supply Arrangement will have no defined end-date and will remain valid until such time as Canada no longer considers it to be advantageous to use it. SECURITY There is no security requirement for this contract. Suppliers working under this Supply Arrangement must not be given access to sensitive information or assets, and must be escorted at all times while on DFO premises. TRADE AGREEMENTS This requirement is subject to the Canada-Chile Free Trade Agreement (CCFTA), Comprehensive and Progressive Agreement for Trans-Pacific Partnership (CPTPP), Canada-European Union Comprehensive Economic and Trade Agreement (CETA), Canada-Colombia Free Trade Agreement, Canada-Peru Free Trade Agreement (CPFTA), Canada-Panama Free Trade Agreement, Canada-Korea Free Trade Agreement (CKFTA), Canada–Ukraine Free Trade Agreement, Canada-Honduras Free Trade Agreement, Canada-United Kingdom Trade Continuity Agreement, World Trade Organization–Agreement on Government Procurement (WTO-GPA), and the Canadian Free Trade Agreement (CFTA). MANDATORY REQUIREMENTS Arrangements will be evaluated in accordance with the mandatory evaluation criteria as detailed in the Request for Supply Arrangements. Suppliers’ arrangements must clearly demonstrate that they meet all Mandatory Requirements for the proposal to be considered for further evaluation. Arrangements not meeting the mandatory criteria will be excluded from further consideration. Mandatory Criteria M1 The Supplier must have experience in one or more of the following: 1. surveying 2. retrieving ghost gear from in water 3. transporting ghost gear 4. responsibly disposing of ghost gear 4. Returning of identifiable gear IMPORTANT NOTICE on Insurance Requirements: At the Request for Proposal (RFP) stage, the Offeror will be required to provide valid certificates of insurance demonstrating that the insurance coverage applicable to the nature of the work is in place and maintained. title: Refrigeration and HVAC Services at the Pacific Biological Station (PBS), Nanaimo, British Columbia (B.C.).
description: BACKGROUND INFORMATION Canada is seeking offers from Offerors to provide refrigeration and HVAC maintenance and repair services to the Pacific Biological Station (PBS) of the Department of Fisheries and Oceans Canada (DFO) located in Nanaimo B.C. Canada intends to issue up to two (2) Standing Offers. Compliant offers will be ranked in ascending order according to their total evaluated price. The compliant offer with the lowest evaluated price will be ranked first, and the compliant offer with the second-lowest evaluated price will be ranked second. Canada may issue fewer than two Standing Offers if fewer than two compliant offers are received. SCOPE OF WORK The Contractor must provide all labour, materials, tools, equipment, supervision, and travel necessary to deliver refrigeration and HVAC maintenance and repair services on an as-and-when-requested basis by means of a Call-up against the Standing Offer at the Pacific Biological Station (PBS), Nanaimo, British Columbia, for the Department of Fisheries and Oceans Canada (DFO). All work must be performed in accordance with the applicable federal and provincial codes, regulations, and standards listed under the References section of this standing offer. Where discrepancies exist between codes, the most stringent requirement applies. A. Services Services required under this standing offer include, but are not limited to: a. Assembling pipe sections, tubing, and fittings using couplings, clamps, screws, bolts, cement, plastic solvent, caulking, soldering, brazing, and welding equipment; b. Filling pipes or HVAC fixtures with water or air and observing pressure gauges to detect and locate leaks; c. Servicing glycol heating and cooling loops; d. Servicing and installing boilers (steam and condensing) and associated equipment; e. Servicing rooftop units, heat pumps, and hydronic heating systems; f. Servicing heat exchangers; g. Reviewing blueprints, building codes, and specifications to determine work details and procedures; h. Preparing written cost estimates for labour and materials prior to commencing work (see Section 7 — Scheduling); i. Studying building plans and inspecting structures to assess material and equipment needs, establish pipe installation sequences, and plan installations around obstructions such as electrical wiring; j. Maintaining records of all assignments and producing detailed work reports; k. Performing calculations and planning for complex or large-scale jobs; l. Locating and marking positions of pipe installations, connections, passage holes, and fixtures using precision measuring instruments including rulers and laser levels; m. Measuring, cutting, threading, and bending pipe to required angles using hand and power tools, including pipe cutters, pipe-threading machines, and pipe-bending machines; n. Installing pipe assemblies, fittings, and valves for all HVAC equipment; o. Cutting openings in structures to accommodate pipes and pipe fittings using hand and power tools; p. Hanging steel supports from ceiling joists (concrete, steel, or wood) to hold pipes in place; q. Repairing and maintaining HVAC equipment, including replacing defective components, mending or replacing broken pipes, and clearing clogged drains; r. Directing workers engaged in pipe cutting, preassembly, and installation of plumbing systems and components; and s. Supplying and installing stainless steel, ABS, and PVC piping, valves, and associated fixtures for HVAC equipment. B. Equipment Equipment covered under this standing offer includes, but is not limited to: • Distribution piping systems: PVC, ABS, steel, stainless steel, copper, cast iron, PEX, and flexible steel-braided; • Water and glycol circulation pumps; • Sump pumps; • Valves: ball, gate, butterfly, globe, pinch, disc check, and equivalent types; • Safety valves associated with the ammonia refrigeration system; • Glycol heating loop equipment; • Boilers: steam and condensing; • Rooftop units, heat pumps, and hydronic heating systems; • Air compressors; • Air dryers; and • Heat exchangers. CALL-UP PROCEDURES – RIGHT OF FIRST REFUSAL 1. Call-up by Authorized Representative. The Identified User’s authorized representative places a Call-up under the Standing Offer for goods, services, or both included in, and at the prices and in accordance with the terms and conditions specified in, the Standing Offer. 2. Multiple Standing Offers. Call-ups will be issued using a right of first refusal basis: The call-up procedures require that when a requirement is identified, the Identified User will contact the highest-ranked offeror to determine if the requirement can be satisfied by that offeror. If the highest-ranked offeror is able to meet the requirement, a call-up is made against its standing offer. If that offeror is unable to meet the requirement, the identified user will contact the next ranked offeror. The identified user will continue and proceed as above until one offeror indicates that it can meet the requirement of the call-up. In other words, call-ups are made based on the “right of first refusal” basis. When the highest-ranked offeror is unable to fulfill the need, the identified user is required to document its file appropriately. The resulting call-ups are considered competitive and the competitive call-up authorities can be used. LOCATION OF WORK Pacific Biological Station, Nanaimo, British Columbia. Services will be provided at a multi-building research campus comprising laboratories, office buildings, aquaculture facilities, refrigeration systems, and associated infrastructure. STANDING OFFER PERIOD The period for issuing Call-ups and providing services against the Standing Offer is from Standing Offer issuance to the date that is five (5) years thereafter (the “Expiry Date”), inclusive. TRAVEL AND LIVING EXPENSES Canada will not pay any travel or living expenses associated with performing the Work. SECURITY REQUIREMENTS There are no security requirements associated with this solicitation of offers or the Standing Offer; however, security requirements may be applicable at the time of issuance of Call-ups. Trade Agreements This procurement is subject to the provisions of the Canadian Free Trade Agreement (CFTA), the World Trade Organization Agreement on Government Procurement (WTO-GPA), the Canada-European Union Comprehensive Economic and Trade Agreement (CETA), the Comprehensive and Progressive Agreement for Trans-Pacific Partnership (CPTPP), the Canada-United Kingdom Trade Continuity Agreement (CUKTCA), and other applicable trade agreements.

title: Design, Installation, Maintenance and Support of Electronic Security Systems
description: Given the evolving threat environment both in Canada and internationally, NRCan is focused on strengthening the physical security posture of its facilities. This includes improving access control, surveillance, and intrusion detection capabilities to ensure personnel safety and operational continuity. NRCan operates an electronic security and surveillance system consisting of access control, video management, and intrusion detection systems deployed across multiple locations nationwide. The system is maintained through a combination of in-house IT and security resources, as well as contracted security system support and integration services. The system transitioned from legacy analog infrastructure to an IP-based architecture between 2016 and 2020, with ongoing enhancements through 2023. The current security system is built on a hybrid cloud and on-premises architecture, designed to balance cost and performance with confidentiality, integrity, and availability requirements. The system includes approximately 500 card readers and 500 cameras across more than 25 sites and is monitored through the NRCan Security Operations Control Centre (SOCC) located at 580 Booth Street in Ottawa, Ontario.

title: Netherlands – Transport services (excl. Waste transport) – Deelbakfietsen Ede
description: De Gemeente Ede wenst de exploitatie van deelauto's in Ede-Centrum en elektrische deelbakfietsen in de hele Gemeente Ede in de markt te leggen middels concessies. Met deze concessies beoogt de Gemeente een kwalitatief, toekomstbestendig en toegankelijk aanbod van deelauto’s en elektrische deelbakfietsen te realiseren, passend bij de ruimtelijke ontwikkeling van het centrumgebied en de mobiliteitsopgaven van de Gemeente. In verband met de verschillende markten en de verschillende concessiegebieden voor deelauto’s en elektrische bakfietsen kiest de Gemeente ervoor om deze concessies middels twee aanbestedingen uit te vragen: één voor elektrische deelbakfietsen en één voor deelauto's. Deze aanbesteding betreft de aanbesteding elektrische deelbakfietsen. De opdracht betreft de concessie voor de exploitatie van elektrische deelbakfietsen in de Gemeente Ede. De concessie wordt uitgevoerd binnen drie regimes: • Regime 1: basisaanbod deelbakfietsen in Ede-Centrum binnen het werkingsgebied Mobiliteitsfonds (zoals weergegeven in Bijlage 2); • Regime 2: het behouden van aanbod van deelbakfietsen op 14 reeds bewezen locaties. • Regime 3: organische uitbreiding in de rest van Ede;

title: France – Guard services – 26.741.01 SÉCURISATION DES LOCAUX ET GESTION A DISTANCE PAR TELESURVEILLANCE DES SITES DE LA CAISSE PRIMAIRE CENTRALE D’ASSURANCE MALADIE DES BOUCHES-DU-RHONE
description: Lot N°1 - SÉCURISATION RECURRENTE DES LOCAUX DE LA CPCAM DES BOUCHES-DU-RHONE ET SECURISATION PONCTUELLE : Pour le lot n°1, il est attendu : - La sécurisation des agents, des assurés et le contrôle d’accès de neuf sites comprenant le Centre Administratif de Valmante et huit agences par la mise à disposition d’agents de sécurité sur les sites concernés ; - La sécurisation ponctuelle à la demande en cas d’évènements exceptionnels, hors sécurisation à la demande énoncée dans le lot 2, concernant l'ensemble des sites. Il s’agit ici d’assurer la sécurité des agents et des assurés en cas d’évènements exceptionnels pouvant porter atteinte à leur intégrité physique (ex : grèves, manifestations externes et internes, agressions verbales et /ou physiques dans l’une des agences, etc …) Lot N°2 – GESTION DE LA SECURITE DES SITES DE LA CPCAM DES BOUCHES-DU-RHONE PAR TELESURVEILLANCE, INTERVENTIONS ET GARDIENNAGE D’URGENCE Pour le lot n°2, il est attendu : - La gestion à distance concernant l'ensemble des sites par télésurveillance ; - La gestion des interventions suite à un déclenchement d’alarme ou à la demande de la CPCAM des Bouches-du-Rhône ou d’un appel extérieur concernant l'ensemble des sites (levée de doute) ; - Gardiennage d’urgence à la demande concernant l’ensemble des sites (limitée à 4 semaines maximum). Il s’agit ici d’assurer le gardiennage des bâtiments suite à une intervention ayant relevé un risque pour celui-ci (ex : intrusion, dysfonctionnement, faille sécuritaire, etc) Les missions relevant du présent accord-cadre doivent permettre d’assurer la sécurité incendie, de surveiller l’accès aux locaux des sites, de prévenir, intervenir, et contrôler toute action suspecte sur le site, accueillir, renseigner, secourir tout individu en difficulté.

title: France – Health services – MAFA n°26.533.03 PRESTATIONS DE SERVICE DE PREVENTION ET DE SANTE AU TRAVAIL INTERENTREPRISES (SPSTI) POUR LA CPCAM DES BOUCHES-DU-RHONE
description: La CPCAM des Bouches-du-Rhone souhaite s'allouer les services d'un SPSTI afin d'assurer la sécurité et la santé (physique et mentale) de ses salariés et d'éviter leur altération du fait du travail. Le marché se déroulera sous la forme d'un accord-cadre à bons de commande et concerne l'ensemble des agents de la CPCAM des Bouches-du-Rhône (2362 agents au 01/08/26) situé sur plusieurs sites présents sur le département.

title: Travel Management Office (TMO) Travel Program (Defense Travel System (DTS) & Government Travel Charge Card (GTCC)) and Mail Management Center (MMC) Technical and Administrative Support Services.
description: This is a SOURCES SOUGHT NOTICE (SSN) announcement. SSNs are issued to assist the Agency in performing market research to determine industry interest and capability. No proposals are being requested or accepted with this synopsis. THIS IS NOT A SOLICITATION FOR PROPOSALS AND NO CONTRACT SHALL BE AWARDED FROM THIS SYNOPSIS. Therefore, no proposals are being requested or accepted in response to this SSN. In accordance with (IAW) Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) Part 10, SSP is conducting market research to determine if sources are capable of successfully performing the requirements identified in this SSN. Specifically, SSP is seeking capable firms to provide Travel Management Office (TMO) Travel Program support for the Defense Travel System (DTS) and Government Travel Charge Card (GTCC), as well as Mail Management Center (MMC) technical and administrative support services for Strategic Systems Programs. The requirement is currently anticipating a Firm-Fixed-Price, Level-of-Effort (FFP-LOE), Term Contract CLIN support for a five-year ordering period from 10 May 2027 through 9 May 2032. Support includes travel program management, help desk support, travel auditing and analysis, GTCC administrative support, and official mail handling operations.

title: Fitness Center O&M Sources Sought
description: PLEASE SUBMIT ALL RESPONSES TO THIS SOURCES SOUGHT TO JAMIE MELZER-COMPTON AT JLMELZER@FBI.GOV BY TUESDAY, OCTOBER 13, 2026, AT 10:00 AM ET. Introduction This notice is for informational purposes only. This is not a request for proposal or quote. It does not constitute a solicitation and shall not be construed as a commitment by the government. Responses in any form are not offers and the government is under no obligation to award a contract as a result of this announcement. No funds are available to pay for preparation of responses to this announcement. Any information submitted by respondents to this technical description is strictly voluntary. Background The Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) is issuing this Sources Sought synopsis as a means of conducting market research to identify parties having an interest in and the resources to support this requirement for establishing, managing, and operating Fitness Center Operations and Maintenance (O&M) Services. The Government expects the Contractor to operate the Fitness Center at FBI Redstone to include on-site fitness center coordination, program coordinator, certified personal trainer, equipment maintenance and repair staff, fitness center management staff and ensure a complete, effective, well-balanced, exercise and equipment maintenance program. The result of this market research will contribute to determining the method of procurement. The applicable North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) code assigned to this procurement is 713940. The total period of performance for this contract, to include all options, shall not exceed five (5) calendar years. Contractor Qualifications If your organization has the potential capacity to perform these contract services, please provide the following information: Firm Information: Organization name (Legal/DBA), Address, Point of Contact (POC), E-mail address, Website address, Telephone number, UEI Number Cage Code, Facility Clearance (if applicable), GSA Schedule (if applicable), and Size and type of ownership for the organization A brief description of at least two (2), but no more than three (3), Fitness Center O&M services similar to the requirements described within the Background Section above. The prior services provided shall be within the past five (5) years. Minimum information should include the following: contract number, total contract value, project location, period of performance, and a brief description of the services. Provide a general statement of your qualifications, capabilities, and ability to perform the required types of work described. If significant subcontracting or teaming is anticipated in order to deliver technical capability, organizations should address the administrative and management structure of such arrangements. Information and suggestions that may encourage new, different, or innovative approaches that would result in products, solutions, and direct savings to the FBI. Contemplated Requirement The FBI is issuing this Sources Sought to: Gather industry information on Fitness Center Operations and Maintenance (O&M) Services at FBI Redstone. Request information on any industry changes or improvements that the FBI should consider when looking to achieve products and capabilities that meet requirements and are compatible with the commercial environment. Request information on potential barriers to obtaining solutions that meet objectives needed to accomplish stated requirements. The government will evaluate market information to ascertain potential market capacity to: Provide services consistent in scope and scale with those described in this notice and otherwise anticipated. Secure and apply the full range of corporate financial, human capital, and technical resources required to successfully perform similar requirements. Implement a successful project management plan that includes compliance with program schedules; cost containment; meeting and tracking performance; hiring and retention of key personnel and risk mitigation. Provide services under a performance-based service acquisition contract. Submission Instructions: Interested parties who consider themselves qualified to perform the above-listed services are invited to submit a response to this Sources Sought Notice by Tuesday, October 13, 2026 by 10:00 AM ET to JLMELZER@fbi.gov. Based on the responses to this Sources Sought notice/market research, this requirement may be set-aside for small businesses or procured through full and open competition, and multiple awards may be made. Responses shall not include: Proposals or Offers. Requests to be considered for award or to be notified of a future solicitation. Requests to be added to a mailing list or distribution list. Questions or comments not related to this Sources Sought. Telephone inquiries will not be accepted or acknowledged, and no feedback or evaluations will be provided to companies regarding their submissions. title: Netherlands – Engineering services – Overeenkomst ingenieursdiensten civieltechnische werken gemeente Bergeijk
description: De opdracht bestaat uit het uitvoeren van ontwerp, (project) engineering, project (bege-)leiding en ondersteuning binnen cultuur – en civieltechnische projecten. Hoofdonderdelen: het verrichten van ontwerp werkzaamheden bij herinrichtingen met (burger)participatie het verrichten van cultuur- en civieltechnisch tekenwerk; het bepalen van hoeveelheden t.b.v. bestekvoorbereiding; het realiseren van RAW bestekken inclusief bijlagen; het schrijven van de nota’s van Inlichtingen; controleren winnende offertes; het houden van toezicht en directie; advieswerkzaamheden op het gebied van verkeer, stedenbouw, landschapsarchitectuur, bestratingen en milieu; ondersteunende werkzaamheden bij trajecten met (burger)participatie; het begeleiden van door derden uit te voeren onderzoeken; overige werkzaamheden indien van toepassing. Het betreft ingenieursopdrachten met een geschatte waarde tot € 100.000,- exclusief btw per deelopdracht. De uit te voeren werkzaamheden liggen binnen de gemeentegrenzen van de gemeente Bergeijk en vallen onder haar verantwoordelijkheid. De gemeente zou voor iedere deelopdracht een separate aanbesteding kunnen doorlopen. Echter gezien de waarde van de deelopdrachten wordt juist gekozen om deze onder te brengen in een raamovereenkomst, zodat dit de doelmatigheid van opdrachtverstrekking ten goede komt. Hierdoor is er sprake van een samengevoegde opdracht. De inschrijvers kunnen de werkzaamheden zonder of met een gering aantal onderaannemers uitvoeren: zij hebben doorgaans alle disciplines in huis. Splitsen in percelen die onafhankelijk van elkaar kunnen worden gegund, leidt niet tot een betere toegankelijkheid voor het mkb, maar tot extra activiteiten en dus meer inefficiëntie en dus meer kosten. De opdracht is als geheel toegankelijk voor het mkb. Daarom wordt er geen perceelindeling toegepast waarbij de percelen onafhankelijk van elkaar kunnen worden gegund. De opdrachtgever gaat met twee partijen een overeenkomst aan. De opdrachten worden evenredig op basis van omzet verdeeld. De overeenkomst wordt aangegaan voor een periode van minimaal twee jaar en maximaal zes jaar. De ingangsdatum van de overeenkomst is 1 februari 2027.

description: ***THIS IS A REQUEST FOR INFORMATION (RFI) NOTICE*** BACKGROUND NIST is conducting market research to support acquisition planning and budget development for a possible future contract, or series of contracts, related to the review of commercialization plans submitted with NIST Small Business Innovation Research (SBIR) proposals. Your organization�s ability to identify and address organizational and individual conflicts of interest. Your ability to execute nondisclosure agreements and securely receive, handle, store, and dispose of proprietary proposal information. Any assumptions that may affect your estimate, including anticipated plan length, evaluation criteria, required documentation, meetings, or turnaround time. or estimating purposes, respondents may assume the following unless otherwise stated: Estimated commercialization-plan length: 2 to 15 pages Estimated number of proposals: 20 to 30 Expected review period: 15 - 30 days Anticipated turnaround time per proposal: 15 - 30 days Required deliverables: Advisory numerical score and written comments via an online peer review system Identify any aspects of the NIST market research notice, including instructions, and draft minimum specifications in the BACKGROUND section you cannot meet and state why. title: Civilian Armored Vehicle Manufacturers
description: Civilian Armored Vehicle Manufacturers NOTICE: The purpose of this notice is for information and planning purposes only and does not constitute a solicitation. OVERVIEW The U.S. Department of State is conducting market research to identify qualified sources capable of providing civilian armored vehicles. This Sources Sought Notice requests information from civilian armored vehicle upfitters and manufacturers to assist in acquisition planning. NAICS Code: 336211 � Motor Vehicle Body Manufacturing Small Business Size Standard: 1,000 employees PURPOSE This Sources Sought Notice seeks to identify potential vendors that specialize in civilian armored vehicles. The Government will only accept responses from firms that perform the actual armoring work from start to finish. Responses from brokers or intermediaries will not be accepted. MANUFACTURING LOCATION REQUIREMENT All vehicle armoring work under any resultant contract shall be performed at facilities located in the United States. The resultant contract will not allow the Contractor to perform or subcontract any armoring work to facilities located in countries subject to U.S. sanctions or export control restrictions. ANTICIPATED CONTRACT DETAILS Contract Type: Indefinite Delivery Indefinite Quantity (IDIQ) Period of Performance: One (1) year base period plus nine (9) twelve-month option periods INFORMATION REQUESTED Interested parties should provide the following information in their response: 1. Company Information a. Company name b. Company address c. Point of contact (POC) name, phone number, and email address d. DUNS number (or UEI if transitioned) 2. Small Business Status a. Indicate whether your company is a small business under NAICS code 336211 b. If applicable, list the socioeconomic category in which your company belongs (e.g., 8(a), HUBZone, SDVOSB, WOSB) 3. SAM Registration a. Confirm that your company is registered in the System for Award Management (SAM) i. Provide SAM UEI number 4. Capability Statement (20-page maximum), focusing on your firm's ability to armor various types of passenger vehicles: a. Armoring Experience � Provide details of vehicle armoring experience in the private and/or public sectors for the previous 10 years, including: i. Types of vehicles armored; make, model, and model year going back no further than 10 years. ii. Example use cases of past vehicles armored (e.g., cargo transport, VIP protection). iii. Ballistic and blast protection levels achieved for standards such as NIJ, VPAM, STANAG, etc., and any non-standard protection requirements met. iv. Fabrication capability for opaque armor materials, and types and thicknesses of materials used in previous armored vehicles. v. Client references (if releasable). b. Contract Volume and Track Record i. Total dollar value of vehicle armoring contracts/orders performed annually over the past 3 years. ii. Largest single order (by vehicle quantity and dollar value) completed within a 12-month period. c. Manufacturing Capabilities i. Location(s) of manufacturing facility/facilities. ii. Any subcontractors used in vehicle production. iii. Production capacity in vehicles per year. iv. Current production lead time, from contract/order award to delivery, for a single vehicle and for a batch order (e.g., 10, 25, 50 vehicles). v. Surge capacity: ability to increase production temporarily to meet urgent Government requirements, and associated timelines. vi. Quality certifications (e.g., ISO, industry-specific certifications). 5. Facility Security Clearances a. Details regarding current and/or past facility security clearances (e.g., FCL level and expiration date) 6. GSA Schedule (if applicable) a. GSA Schedule number b. Period of performance 7. Acquisition Strategy and Contract Structure Feedback a. Does your firm have experience performing under an IDIQ contract with multiple 12-month option periods? If so, please describe. b. Would your firm be able to compete effectively if this requirement is set aside for small business, 8(a), HUBZone, SDVOSB, or WOSB concerns? Please explain any concerns with a small business set-aside. c. Based on your knowledge of the industry, are you aware of at least two other capable, responsible small businesses that could perform this requirement? (This helps the Government assess set-aside feasibility under the Rule of Two.) d. Would your firm prefer or recommend a single-award IDIQ or a multiple-award IDIQ for this requirement? Please explain the rationale. e. Do you have experience with, or a preference for, Firm-Fixed-Price (FFP) task/delivery orders versus other pricing arrangements (e.g., FFP with economic price adjustment) for this type of work, given potential material cost volatility (e.g., steel, ballistic glass, composites)? f. What is a reasonable Rough Order of Magnitude (ROM) cost range per vehicle for common armoring configurations (e.g., B4/B6 level sedan, B7 level SUV), if you are able to share this for planning purposes? g. Are there minimum order quantities or dollar thresholds your firm would require to make individual task orders economically viable? h. What is your firm's standard warranty period and terms for armoring work performed, including coverage for parts, labor, and any workmanship defects? i. Is your firm capable of providing warranty support at U.S. Department of State posts located overseas? If so, please describe how this support would be delivered, including: Delivery method � e.g., dispatch of traveling technicians from the U.S. or a regional hub, use of vetted local subcontractors/service partners, or a combination of both; Coordination with post � how your firm would coordinate with the post's General Services Office (GSO) or Facilities Management team to schedule access, obtain necessary country clearances, and comply with local security and customs requirements; Response times � anticipated timeframes for initial response and on-site arrival, accounting for post location (e.g., high-threat vs. standard posts) and regional logistics; Parts and logistics � how replacement parts or materials would be sourced and shipped to the post, including any customs, or import/export control considerations; and Limitations � any posts, regions, or security environments where your firm would be unable to provide direct warranty service, and what alternative arrangements (e.g., remote technical support, depot-level repair) would apply in those cases. j. Does your firm have bonding capacity sufficient to support a multi-year IDIQ of this size? If comfortable sharing, please indicate your bonding capacity or capacity range. k. Would your firm be interested in, or already positioned for, teaming or subcontracting arrangements with other firms to meet the full scope of this requirement? l. Are there any customer-furnished vehicle chassis considerations (e.g., Government-furnished base vehicles vs. contractor-procured) that would affect your proposed approach or pricing? m. Do you foresee any barriers (e.g., export control licensing, material sourcing, facility capacity) that could limit competition or timely performance under this requirement? SUBMISSION INSTRUCTIONS Deadline: Responses must be received no later than 11:00 AM EST on October 13, 2026. Submission Method: All responses, including attachments and any questions regarding this Notice, should be submitted electronically to: Maria Anguiano: anguianom@state.gov Wanda I. Cruz: cruzwi@state.gov Subject Line: Sources Sought Response � Motor Vehicle Body Manufacturing

title: Ireland – Radioactive-, toxic-, medical- and hazardous waste services – Collection and Disposal of Category 1 Waste from Dublin Airport Passenger Terminals and Airside Stables
description: Due to the risk of introducing diseases into the European Union (EU) from third countries, there are strict rules and regulations around animal products and plants and plant products entering the EU. Any products that are prohibited from entry are seized and disposed of as Category 1 waste. Prohibited products in passengers’ luggage on airplanes poses a very particular risk to public, animal and plant health, resulting in its disposal being strictly regulated. Accordingly, there are controls are in place to ensure that seizures of prohibited food or plants at Dublin Airport is controlled and disposed of in a manner that minimises risk to public, animal and plant health. Past outbreaks of diseases (e.g. Foot and Mouth Disease) demonstrate the risks posed by products of animal origin, animal by-products (ABP) and plants being introduced to Ireland through travel. The successful tenderer will be responsible for the removal, emptying, cleaning and disinfection of the Department of Agriculture, Food and Marine bins at following locations in Dublin Airport: • Terminal One • Terminal Two • Airside Stables It must be noted the successful tenderer must be registered to land Category 1 waste under Article 23 of Regulation (EC) 1069/2009 and must be registered prior to commencing operations. The operator must also ensure to abide by all relevant requirements set out in national (SI 187 2014) and EU Legislation (Regulations 1069/2009 and 142/2011). Full details in Notice titled CN25ALander, published with the tender documents. Also please note there are Terms and Conditions from Dublin Airport Authority that the successful tenderer must comply with to operate at the airport, please refer to "Dublin Airport Authority miscellaneous charges booklet 2026" published with the tender documents.

title: Trade and Cargo Academy
description: **Note: The sources sought originally posted as W912HP27RA001 - Due to technical issues with ACWS a new solicitation number was pulled. The United States Army Corps of Engineers (USACE) Charleston District (SAC) has a new requirement for construction of a Trade and Cargo Academy at the Federal Law Enforcement Training Center (FLETC). The requirement will include hazardous material abatement and selective demolition of the current vacant 30,000 SF, three-story building, while preserving the existing main lobby and ensuring uninterrupted utility service to the occupied east wing. In its place, a new 28,400 SF, two-story, flood-resilient facility will be constructed. Due to poor soil quality and its location within FEMA Zone AE, the TCA will use a deep precast concrete pile foundation with pile-supported slabs, a heavy-duty steel frame to withstand high wind/seismic demands, a modern rainscreen envelope, and fully integrated building systems (HVAC, LED lighting, and security infrastructure). The interior will have space for instructional use on the first floor (including classrooms, an auditorium, and production spaces) and administrative open offices on the second floor. FLETC also has a requirement for the construction of a new Cargo Security and Seized Property Training Facility (CSSPTF), a separate one-story 5,985 SF facility purpose-built to support U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP) training. Specifically designed for hands-on vehicle/cargo inspection, evidence processing, and simulated seized property storage, this site-adapted facility will also be elevated on a deep pile foundation to comply with stringent floodplain requirements. A key engineering focus for this site is the implementation of pile-supported stormwater piping under paved areas to mitigate soil settlement risks. Both facilities are engineered for a minimum 40-year operational lifespan, integrating highly durable, low-maintenance coastal materials, and will comply fully with the latest federal energy conservation standards, DHS security criteria, and 2021 building codes. These facilities are essential for the increased student enrollment and additional courses offered supporting FLETC Charleston.

title: Request for Information (RFI) � Resources, Engagement, and Action for Community Health: State and Local Stakeholder Engagement Support
description: The Health Resources and Services Administration (HRSA), Office of Acquisition Management and Policy (OAMP), is conducting market research to identify qualified organizations capable of supporting a potential agency-wide initiative focused on state and local stakeholder engagement, information sharing, technical assistance, and coordination across HRSA Bureaus and Offices. HRSA is seeking information regarding industry capabilities to engage established national, state, and local networks; gather, analyze, and communicate information concerning emerging health needs, policy and implementation developments, workforce trends, and effective practices; convene stakeholders for peer learning and technical assistance; and disseminate HRSA resources and information through established networks. This Request for Information (RFI) is issued solely for market research and acquisition planning purposes. It does not constitute a solicitation, Request for Proposal (RFP), or Request for Quotation (RFQ), and does not obligate the Government to issue a solicitation or award a contract. Interested organizations should review the attached RFI for the complete program background, potential activities and deliverables, requested capability information, response instructions, and submission requirements. Responses are due no later than 12:00 PM ET on October 13, 2026.

title: Technical Services
description: This Special Notice is to advise interested members of the Training and Readiness Accelerator II (TReX 11), as well as other interested members within the U.S. technology base, that a Request for Solutions (RFS) has been issued by Advanced Technology International (ATI) for Future Training Directorate (FTD) The purpose of the Training and Readiness Accelerator II (TReX II} is to spur innovative development, demonstration, and expedited delivery of prototypes to increase Warfighter readiness via modeling, simulation, education/training, experimental validation, and military readiness focused projects. A consortium has been established to develop prototypes directly relevant to enhancing the mission effectiveness of military personnel and the supporting platforms, systems, components, or materials proposed to be acquired or developed by the Department of Defense (DOD), or to improvement of platforms, systems, components, or materials in use by the Armed Forces. Link for TREX Il-https://www.trexii.org/ This prototype project will enhance the mission effectiveness of military personnel by improving the platforms, business systems and business procedures within the Future Training Directorate (FTD). The contractor shall collect, analyze, and archive data that will support programmatic, business initiative requirements, develop and maintain related study databases and/or websites formatted for multiple toolsets, including scenario laydowns and system representations utilized within analytic tools for participation in joint experimentation, initiatives and other analysis forums. The contractor shall support the Government by assisting and performing integrated analysis, evaluations and/or assessments of organizational structures, missions, architectures with relevant analysis to include for prototyping, modeling and simulation, concepts for the realm of the possible, services, products, systems, and technologies in the areas of doctrine, organization, training, materiel, leadership and education, personnel, facilities, and policy (DOTMLPF-P).
